That methodological error is first introduced in step 7 and then applied to all subsequent members, leading to the wrong outcome.

The agents consistently evaluated whether directors had ever held C‑suite roles rather than whether they held such roles at the time they joined Apple’s board. This is clear from repeated phrasing like “held a C‑suite position before joining,” including for Susan L. Wagner, where the time-of-joining status was not checked.
